primary: median natural JS heap across the 60 return endpoints per process
secondary: peak and final natural JS heap; same 20% guard
frameMetrics: passive rAF gap p95/max and gaps above 50ms per finite process window; these are frame observations, not user latency percentiles
passiveProbe: no per-rAF DOM or bounds scans; membership serialization after the primary heap read
sampleUnits: two fresh desktop Chrome processes per variant, each emulating mobile and containing 60 dependent cycles; zero physical devices
cache: fresh process/context; disabled HTTP cache and service worker; warm in-page cycles
forcedGC: only after each final natural sample, diagnostic kept separately
purpose: matched same-source A/A observer-effect diagnostic, not an application improvement benchmark
